plugin.name: YouTubeMusic
plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Fix unreliable streaming on ARM Linux (Raspberry Pi) by disabling direct ffmpeg CDN URL approach which was silently timing out on ~50% of tracks causing 20-45 second delays. ARM Linux now always uses subprocess yt-dlp pipe which is consistently reliable. Fix yt-dlp Update button on macOS/Windows frozen installs. Fix track duration display before playback starts.
plugin.creator: schmij97
